mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 24 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park under the light of a full moon.

The city has announced that municipal buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the holiday. Please note that Thursday refuse and recycling pickup is delayed until Friday, and the recycling center will be closed those two days.

There is plenty to do in town today with trivia events at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee.
In a report covering November 1 through 15, police responded on November 3 to a two-vehicle crash at CTH M and CTH PB where one driver was cited for operating without headlights.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
